title: Splendor bi suux
intro: Xalaatal lii: ruuh bu sol yéere yu rafet, ba noppi wër ko alal ju ëpp luñu ko mëna xalaat. Nit kooku dafa gëmoon ni seen alal mingi aju ci seen xel mu ñaw, te musu ñu xam fu seen alal joge dëgg. Nit kii dafa doon doxantu ci diggante ñi toppoon benn yonent bu am doole, te nanguwul bépp wooteb woyof. Tay, danuy wane ràññeekaay nit ku am alal ju rëy ju nekkoon seen barabu noppalukaay bu mujj.
clues: Maa ngi dundu ci jamonoy yonent bu woo réew mu dëgër bopp mu ñëw ci dëgg.
Maa ngi bokkoon ci askan wiñ tànn, waaye sama xol dafa sori ci bataaxal bi.
Wurus ak xaalis ñoo ma gëna xëcc bépp ndigalu Yàlla.
Sama néegu alal dafa yaatu ba nit ñu bari mënu ñu woon yëkkati caabi yi.
Dama daanoon ni sama alal moo ma jox ndax sama xam-xam.
Ginaaw ga, suuf si wann naa man ak sama dëkkuwaay yépp, muy àrtu.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
